name: AE crash
description: Renders T08 while a watcher kills about half of the AfterFX.com runs. Every crashed task must fail and be retried.

jobEnvironments.name: Crash AfterFX
jobEnvironments.description: Polls every second and, on a coin flip, kills each new AfterFX.com process as soon as a new file appears in the output directory, mid-render. Stopped on exit so a retry never has two watchers.

embeddedFiles.name: Launch
embeddedFiles.data:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

watch, workdir, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
cmd = [sys.executable, watch, os.path.join(workdir, 'crash_watcher.log'), outdir]
io = dict(stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True)
flags = subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS | subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP
try:
    p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, creationflags=flags | subprocess.CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB, **io)
except OSError:
    p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, creationflags=flags, **io)
with open(os.path.join(workdir, 'crash_watcher.pid'), 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(p.pid))
print(f'Started crash watcher pid {p.pid}', flush=True)

embeddedFiles.data:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

workdir = sys.argv[1]
pid_path = os.path.join(workdir, 'crash_watcher.pid')
if os.path.exists(pid_path):
    with open(pid_path) as f:
        pid = f.read().strip()
    r = subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/PID', pid], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f'Stopped crash watcher pid {pid}: {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr.strip()}', flush=True)
log_path = os.path.join(workdir, 'crash_watcher.log')
if os.path.exists(log_path):
    with open(log_path) as f:
        print(f.read(), flush=True)
